# ASVA

> ASVA is a Windows app for Indian distributors and wholesalers who use TallyPrime and sell on credit. It sends each new Tally bill to the customer on WhatsApp, sends polite payment reminders from the shop's own WhatsApp number timed to each party's credit days, reads the customer's reply, and posts the receipt voucher into Tally when the owner confirms a payment. Customers pay the shop directly by UPI or bank transfer; ASVA never touches the money.

## Quick facts
- What it is: a Windows 10/11 desktop app that runs on the same computer as TallyPrime. Not a Tally plugin and not a mobile app. Customers install nothing.
- What it connects to: TallyPrime (read over Tally's own HTTP port, no TDL or add-on) and the shop's own WhatsApp number.
- What it writes to Tally: only receipt vouchers, and only after the owner confirms the amount. It never changes or deletes existing vouchers and never creates sales vouchers.
- Price: 14-day free trial counted from the day the shop starts, then Lite Rs 699/month (up to 150 active parties), Collect Rs 999/month (up to 400), Recover Rs 1,499/month (up to 1,000, adds AI reply handling and multi-company). Custom above 1,000. No setup fee. An active party is a customer with a WhatsApp number who still owes money.
- Scale: shops on ASVA have collected more than Rs 52 lakh so far; it runs on live Tally books including a shop with more than 2,000 parties.
- Languages: reminders in English by default, or Hinglish for customers the owner chooses. It understands replies in English, Hinglish, Hindi and Tamil.
- Maker: Almmatix, India. Contact on WhatsApp +91 93441 10272 or almmatix@gmail.com.

## How it works, step by step
1. Reads your Tally: every few minutes ASVA reads what is outstanding, party by party and bill by bill.
2. Sends bills and reminders: every new bill reaches the customer on WhatsApp a few minutes after it is made in Tally. Reminders follow each party's credit days, one message per customer listing all their open bills with a UPI pay link.
3. Reads the reply: "paid", a payment screenshot, or a promised date ("will pay on the 5th") pauses reminders and tells the owner. If the money does not arrive, reminders resume. Unclear replies go to the owner instead of being guessed.
4. Posts the payment in Tally: payments line up in one list; the owner checks the amount and ASVA posts the receipt voucher against the oldest bills first.
5. Every evening the owner gets one WhatsApp summary: who paid and who to call tomorrow.

## Safety
- Messages come from the shop's own WhatsApp number, sent slowly: capped per hour, in daytime only, one combined message per customer.
- ASVA never holds or routes money and takes no cut; there is no payment gateway.
- The owner can also run ASVA by WhatsApp message: LIST (who owes), CHECK name, REMIND name, PAID name amount, BILL name amount, DIGEST.

## Who it is for
Distributors and wholesalers in India selling on credit with TallyPrime on Windows: electricals, hardware, chemicals, steel and metals, paints, pipes and fittings, FMCG and pharma distribution.

## When ASVA is a good fit, and when it is not
- Good fit: you use TallyPrime, sell on credit, chase payments by phone or WhatsApp today, and want reminders to go out by themselves from your own number.
- Not the right tool: you need heavy credit-limit control or buyer credit scoring (Kenso is stronger there), or a broad accounting suite (see Takkada or CredFlow). Comparison: https://tryasva.com/compare
